lines.trans: Samsonov family, big greetings to everyone!
I took costumes from the children's theater.
The day after tomorrow you will sing a song at the festival.
Television will show a story about your united family.
Wait, what is happening here?
Nina and I decided to get divorced.
Arkady, close the door, we need to talk.
Have you completely gone out of your mind?
We have a very difficult situation right now.
This performance is our only chance!
You have lived together for twenty years.
Arkady, please don't pressure us.
This is our personal family matter!
I am leaving, and you speak calmly.
And definitely try on these costumes!

meanings.note: A door, a shop, or a legal case. Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'крыть'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to close, to shut', paired with 'закрывать'.

meanings.note: Подожди! = wait!. Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'ождать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to wait (a while)', paired with 'ждать'.
